fixture_notes: The requested mask 7 is applied to one partial-overlap mask and one full-overlap mask, retaining both BIT_COUNT and bitwise intersection behavior.
determinism_notes: Fixed principal IDs, integer masks, requested mask, expression aliases, and final ordering; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE mini_capability_principals (principal_id INT PRIMARY KEY, principal_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, capability_mask INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT principal_id, principal_name, capability_mask & 7 AS matched_mask, BIT_COUNT(capability_mask & 7) AS matched_capabilities FROM mini_capability_principals ORDER BY principal_id
